title: Ox Passion Strawberry Raspberry Mojito Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Strawberry Raspberry Mojito blends sweet summer berries with a twist of citrus and cool Mint for a fresh and fruity cocktail-style vape. Juicy Strawberry and tangy Raspberry provide a bold red-fruit base, lifted by a touch of lime and rounded off with a clean minty finish. It’s a vibrant, layered flavour ideal for vapers who enjoy complex fruit blends with a refreshing edge. Formulated with nicotine salts for rapid nicotine absorption and a smooth throat hit, this e-liquid is blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio and designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. Best suited to pod vape kits, starter pens, and compact refillable systems. Available in both 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, OX Passion Nic Salts offer bold, layered flavour profiles with a consistently smooth finish. Developed by Oxva, a trusted name in vaping hardware, these e-liquids are expertly crafted to pair seamlessly with Oxva XLIM pod kits and other refillable MTL vape devices.
